items: .projects-card creates a card layout with a white background, shadow, and rounded corners for a clean, professional look. The flexible width keeps it responsive.
The project image has rounded corners to match the card style and fills the card width.
The <h3> title uses a responsive font size (clamp) to ensure readability on different screens.
a.visit-link is styles as a clickable link to the project.
.projects-tech-stack, a flex container, contains tags for the technologies used in each project.

blocks.content: This setup organizes each project as a card element with a consistent design and ensures responsiveness across devices.
